Fact: data_scope
What to find: Scope and main characteristics of the training data (domains, languages, geography, modality coverage).
Card sections that often contain it: Training Data

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: SFT corpus has four sources: publicly available permissively licensed datasets, internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling and chain-of-thought, agentic traces across diverse tasks, and curated human-authored data. Finetuning is mostly English instruction-response pairs plus multilingual data covering the supported languages. RL environments span math, code, science, instruction following, tool use, general chat and structured output. The base model was pre-trained on a large-scale English and multilingual corpus.
quotes: the training corpus comprises four sources: (1) publicly available datasets under permissive licenses, (2) internally generated synthetic data targeting reasoning, tool calling, and chain-of-thought capabilities, (3) agentic traces collected across a diverse range of tasks, and (4) a curated selection of human-authored data.
Granite 4.2 models are primarily finetuned using instruction-response pairs mostly in English, but also multilingual data covering the supported languages listed above.
Training spans a broad mix of environments including math, code, science, instruction following, tool use, general chat and structured output.
which was pre-trained on a large-scale English as well as multilingual corpus.
